We celebrated our first anniversary in the Maldives, and it turned into one of the most heartfelt and adventurous trips we have filmed, full of ocean calm, big laughs and honest conversations about what a year together really feels like.

From slow mornings to days spent in and around the water, we stepped out of our comfort zone, tried new things together and soaked in the island life. Even the rain could not take away from the magic of the place.

We also look back at how our story began, what the first year has taught us, and why no relationship is ever perfect. We end the trip with a little anniversary celebration and a lot of gratitude.

This is just the beginning of our Life Of Rahi series. There is a lot more still to come, so keep following along.
